recipes.name: Sugar Chicken inspired by Rick & Morty
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless and skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite size pieces
1 tbsp reserved orange peel, finely sliced
1 small bird’s eye chili, seeds removed + finely sliced
1 1/2 lb chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Recipe Adapted from: Tasty
For the Basic Tempura Chicken
Combine cornstarch, flour, egg, water, vodka, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine. - ¾ cup cornstarch - 1 ½ cup all purpose flour - 1 egg - 1 cup + 2 Tbsp water - ¼ cup vodka - 2 tsp salt
Transfer the chicken to the batter, fold to thoroughly coat the chicken. - 1 ½ lb boneless and skinless chicken thighs cut into bite size pieces
Cover and allow the chicken to rest for 20-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a large high-sided skillet, heat the peanut oil to 350°F. - 72 oz peanut oil
Working in batches, add the chicken to the fry oil and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the chicken has reached an internal temperature of 175°F.
Transfer the fried chicken to a rimmed baking sheet lined with paper towels and repeat with the remaining chicken.
Reserve until ready to use.
For the Orange Sauce
Add vegetable oil to a large skillet and heat over medium heat. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil
Add the garlic cloves, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Cook for 30 seconds - 1 minute or until fragrant. - 2 cloves garlic minced - 1 tbsp ginger grated - ¼ tsp red pepper flakes

Add the sugar, brown sugar, orange juice, white vinegar, rice wine vinegar, and soy sauce. - ¼ cup white sugar - ¼ cup brown sugar packed - ¼ cup store bought orange juice - ¼ cup white vinegar - 2 tbsp soy sauce - ¼ cup rice wine vinegar
Stir to dissolve the sugar and cook over medium-high heat until boiling.
Meanwhile, combine the cornstarch and water in a small bowl to form a slurry. - 2 tbsp cornstarch - 2 tbsp water
Once boiling, add the slurry and cook the sauce while stirring constantly until thickened.
Finish the sauce with a drizzle of the sesame oil and whisk to combine. - 1 ½ tsp sesame oil
Turn the heat to low and add the chicken. Toss or fold to combine and serve over rice. - White rice - For the Basic Tempura Chicken
For the Improved Sugar Chicken
For the Oleo Saccharum
Using a paring knife, cut off the rind of the orange into large strips. Try to avoid cutting off the white pith of the fruit, you only want the zest. - 6 oranges
Combine the orange peels with the sugar in a bowl. Crush or mash the peels with a muddler or potato masher. - 6 oranges - 1 cup sugar
Cover the bowl or transfer the mixture to a sealable container, and let sit at room temperature overnight or up to 24 hours.
Strain the mixture and reserve the liquid. Use immediately or store in the refrigerator until ready to use (up to 4 days).
For the Improved Orange Sauce
Add vegetable oil to a large skillet and heat over medium heat. - Vegetable oil
Add the ginger and garlic cloves. Cook for 30 seconds - 1 minute or until fragrant. - 1 tsp ginger - 2 garlic cloves minced

Combine 1/3 cup oleo Saccharum, brown sugar, MSG, rice wine vinegar, Chinese cooking wine, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, orange peels, and orange juice. Stir to dissolve the sugar and cook over medium-high heat until boiling. - For the Oleo Saccharum - 2 tbsp brown sugar packed - ½ tsp MSG - ¼ cup rice wine vinegar - 1 tbsp Chinese cooking wine - ¼ cup soy sauce - 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine - 1 tbsp reserved orange peel finely sliced - ¼ cup freshly squeezed orange juice
Turn off the heat, add the sliced chilis, and cover the pan. Reserve until ready to use. - 1 small bird’s eye chili seeds removed + finely sliced
For the Improved Sugar Chicken

Combine the chicken with the eggs, rice wine vinegar, and Shaoxing wine in a medium bowl. Let marinate at room temperature for 20-30 minutes. - 1 ½ lb chicken breasts cut into bite size pieces - 2 eggs - 1 tbsp rice wine vinegar - 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine
Meanwhile, start heating the peanut oil, in a large high-sided skillet, to 350°F. - 72 oz peanut oil
In a small baking sheet or pie pan, combine rice flour, salt, baking powder, MSG, and white pepper. - 1 cup rice flour - 2 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp baking powder - ¼ tsp MSG - ½ tsp white pepper
Transfer the pieces of chicken to the dry dredge and toss to combine.

Working in batches, add the chicken to the oil and fry for 5-7 minutes or until the internal temperature reached 175°F. Transfer the chicken to a large rimmed baking sheet lined with paper towels. Repeat with the remaining chicken.
Combine the cornstarch and water in a small bowl. - 2 tbsp cornstarch - 2 tbsp water
Bring the reserved orange sauce back to a boil and add the cornstarch slurry. Cook until the sauce begins to thicken. - For the Improved Orange Sauce
Finish the sauce with a drizzle of sesame oil and stir to combine. - 1 tsp sesame oil
Add the chicken and toss to combine.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve with white rice. - White rice - green onions thinly sliced
